title: Nim Game
description: Determine if you can win the Nim game given n stones, where you can remove 1-3 stones per turn.
pseudocode:
1. Check if n modulo 4 is equal to 0.
2. If n % 4 == 0, return false (losing position).
3. Otherwise, return true (winning position).

steps.note: Since 4 % 4 == 0, this is a losing position. Return false.
